description: Outcome-based persistent memory for AI coding tools (Claude Code, OpenCode)
release_notes: v0.6.0: Folder-to-profile bindings (roampal profile bind) with a profile routing contract — every client names its profile on every request, the shared server never guesses from its own cwd/env, and no app owns the server (idle self-retirement, single-flight restarts, neutral-cwd spawns, the OpenCode plugin reusing Roampal's own interpreter). One memory-limits table rejects over-limit writes with a rewrite-shorter message instead of silently cutting text; exchange summaries store alone on every platform and Claude Code no longer re-injects already-seen memories. OpenCode scoring requires an explicit cloud opt-in (the silent Zen default is gone), roampal init never wipes or clutters config files, the 4,697-line cli.py is split into a roampal/cli/ package with byte-identical output, and model loading is cache-first. 1122 tests passing, 4 skipped.
